status: Offline source integration design only; no implementation/deployment/device authorization
purpose: Disambiguate actual forward/backward dispatch submissions and host layout values without repeating the uninstrumented failed command.
isolated_scope: Future changes must be in a separate diagnostic Python source tree; preserve frozen P0/P1, native libraries, arithmetic and communication protocols. Diagnostic identities cannot inherit performance qualification.

explicit_phase.action: Set explicit forward or backward context inside these methods around the existing buffer.dispatch call. Supply run/case/session tags from the validator; never infer phase from stack, weights or cached_handle.
explicit_phase.thread_boundary: Do not rely only on a ContextVar set around top-level loss.backward: autograd may execute backward on another host thread. Create the context in the actual backward method.
explicit_phase.semantics: Retain once_differentiable, exact original dispatch args, saved tensors, dtype/cast/gate/dW ordering and exception propagation.

notify_host_snapshot.source: deep_ep/buffers/elastic.py:_notify, existing summary at lines1451-1454 and EPHandle creation
notify_host_snapshot.action: In diagnostic mode only, retain immutable tuples from existing rows and count_list, plus native-session identity. Do not add cpu/item/tolist/device reads: these host lists already exist here.
notify_host_snapshot.boundary: EPHandle.num_recv_tokens_per_expert_list already retains local counts, but EPHandle.rank_rows is a device tensor. Do not reconstruct actual global rows from the expected route or address_stride=max(rows).
notify_host_snapshot.lifecycle: Bind snapshot to the created handle and native session; reject missing/stale or cross-session metadata. Cached backward uses the same immutable host snapshot. No route/count tensor mutation.

native_call_boundary.source: deep_ep/buffers/elastic.py:dispatch immediately surrounding native.dispatch at line962
native_call_boundary.action: Combine explicit phase/case/session tags with handle snapshot and actual session/args; enter DispatchHostTrace.label only for the existing native call. Label cached_handle from the public dispatch entry before a new handle is created.
native_call_boundary.checks: Verify global rows/address_stride, local rows/count sum and session match without collective/device work. Record actual peer_table/optional plan, controls/profiles, metadata pointers/layout and optional existing workspace accessor.
native_call_boundary.fail_closed: Any recorder/native/metadata failure latches stop and propagates through existing error handling; no later operator or next case is admitted. Keep owned cleanup and controller failure convergence.
native_call_boundary.completion: before/native_return/native_error are host submission boundaries, not kernel or device completion; call_sequence is not native generation.

required_cpu_review: Execute actual transformed Python methods with CPU stubs; verify labels both in direct forward and backward on a separate host thread.
Fresh/cached handle metadata retention, legitimate empty local ranks and optional plan; reject missing/stale tags before native invocation.
Compare original native arguments/results/exceptions; verify original frozen files and native libraries unchanged.
No added tensor value reads, device events, barriers, synchronization, routing changes or profiling enablement; verify stop latch.
remaining_non_host_evidence: Actual device context, heap table and translated descriptor writes remain unobserved.
Live mapped-library FD hashes and read-only process sampling need a separately reviewed controller.
Host file flush and metadata add diagnostic overhead; use disabled builds for later formal performance.
execution_policy: Design only. Both hosts currently occupied and1431 cause unresolved; no device queue, retry, launcher or automatic restart. Any future single validation needs evidence-supported primary review.
